lesson: Recording a lesson for later recall takes two steps. memory.candidate is pure and builds {lesson,evidence} into a reviewable candidate with a candidateHash over its content. memory.promote is a write needing its own exact approval and stores it under memory/ keyed by that hash, so a stored entry that does not match its own digest is treated as corrupt and ignored. Recall scores lessons by literal term overlap with the request, so a lesson is found only if it shares vocabulary with the question it should answer. Write a lesson to be self-contained and to use the words a relevant request would actually use.
